plainTranslation: Their Sun in your 1st house: they see you clearly and you feel energized, even validated, around them. Strong mutual recognition - you become more yourself in their presence. Failure mode: you start acting out the version of you they reflect back. Let them see you; don't perform for the mirror.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
